scope.regular_innings: innings 1 and 2; pressure categories applied as match context
scope.additional_innings: retained separately and not mixed into regular pressure/ordinary groups
scope.competitions: all competition records in the supplied dataset are retained
scope.bowling_interpretation: early-collapse context describes pressure on the batting side; it is not automatically treated as pressure on the bowler

metric_definitions.bowling_delivery_records: all recorded delivery rows assigned to the bowler
metric_definitions.candidate_legal_balls: bowling delivery rows excluding extras_type wide and Overstep; Penalty retained in primary count due uncertain event semantics
metric_definitions.candidate_legal_balls_excluding_penalty: same as primary candidate legal balls but also excludes the single Penalty-coded record
metric_definitions.bowler_credited_wickets: is_wicket records with dismissal_type Bowled, Caught, LBW, Stump or Hit Wicket; stumping on wide remains credited; RunOut is not credited
metric_definitions.source_runs_field_sum: sum of runs field only; not complete bowler runs conceded because actual wide/byes/leg-byes are not fully present
metric_definitions.economy_rate: not calculated: total bowler-charged runs cannot be reconstructed reliably from supplied extras fields
metric_definitions.dot_ball_rate: not calculated: byes/leg-byes have missing run values, so zero runs field cannot identify a true dot ball
metric_definitions.boundary_rates: counts supplied is_four/is_six flags; source audit discloses flag mismatches
